subject: Post-demo recap & next steps \u0014 buying committee alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@finedge.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@finedge.com>, Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@finedge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps  buying committee alignment

Hi Emily, Carlos, Claire 

Thanks again for taking the time today  really appreciated the buying committee showing up. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Demo highlights (what we showed)
- Live walkthrough of Redwood inference runtime and canary failover behavior
- Cost-control dashboard and per-route token breakdowns
- Private deployment options (VPC) and KMS integration overview

2) Key decision criteria you mentioned
- Predictable per-token economics and cost controls (Carlos)
- SOC2 and data residency / retention guarantees (Claire)
- Procurement timeline and contract flexibility (procurement team)

3) Stakeholder mapping (as I understand it)
- Economic buyer / final sign-off: Carlos Ruiz (CFO)
- Security / compliance: Claire O'Neill (Head of Security)
- Procurement / SOW: procurement@finedge.com
- Technical champion: Emily Barnes (Product Lead)

4) Action items (owners + tentative dates)
- Redwood: Provide SOC2 summary, data retention policy, and baseline SAML/KMS docs  by Mon 2026-11-23 (Vivek + Neha) [Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf]
- FinEdge: Confirm procurement timeline and any mandatory contract clauses  by Wed 2026-11-25 (Carlos / procurement)
- Schedule security deep-dive (technical + security teams)  propose 60-min window next week; please share availability

Attachments: demo-recording-20261120.mp4 (recording), product-one-pager.pdf, MA-template-v1.docx
Links: HubSpot deal & shared drive for collateral (see links below)

Please reply with any corrections to the stakeholder mapping or if you'd like anything else included. If that mapping looks right, can we lock in a security deep-dive for next week? 

Thanks  happy to adjust based on your timelines.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: product-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 480KB)]
[Attachment: demo-recording-20261120.mp4 (MP4, 120MB)]
[Attachment: MA-template-v1.docx (DOCX, 120KB)]

From: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@finedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@finedge.com>, Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@finedge.com>, procurement@finedge.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps  buying committee alignment

Thanks Marissa  great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Stakeholders: Confirmed  Carlos is the economic buyer and will own budget sign-off. Claire is our security lead; she'll want a 6090 minute technical security review before we move legal/procurement.
- Procurement timeline: Our procurement team is aiming for an approved SOW by 2026-12-05 if security review completes this week. procurement@finedge.com is the right inbox for routing contract redlines.
- Decision criteria: In addition to SOC2, Carlos will want an analysis of expected per-ticket unit cost savings and a delta vs our current provider for our 2M monthly token volume estimate. Can Redwood provide a modeled cost comparison?

Claire: adding you for confirmation of any additional compliance docs you need.

Emily Barnes
Product Lead, FinEdge
emily.barnes@finedge.com

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 09:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@finedge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@finedge.com>, Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@finedge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps  buying committee alignment

Hi Emily, Carlos, Claire 

Thanks for the clarifications. Quick answers and what we'll deliver this week: 

- Cost model: We'll run a modeled per-month estimate for your 2M token volume, including dedicated vs hosted pricing, and a recommended config (batching, KV cache settings, and a quantization profile) to hit your target economics. Expect that by Tue 2026-11-24. (Owner: Neha + Vivek)

- Security/compliance: We'll share our SOC2 summary and a short data retention & deletion policy today. For the technical deep-dive, propose two 60-min slots:
  • Tue 2026-11-24 10:00–11:00 PT
  • Wed 2026-11-25 13:00–14:00 PT
Please confirm which works for Claire and the security team. We'll bring our security engineer and solutions architect.

- Contract / procurement: We can accept redlines against the MA-template-v1.docx and are open to a standard SOW-based purchase. For procurement, we can loop in legal at the right time once redlines are identified.

Attached: SOC2-summary.pdf (high level)

Cheers,
Vivek
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@finedge.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@finedge.com>, Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@finedge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@finedge.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps  buying committee alignment

Thanks all  locking next steps: 

- FinEdge to confirm security deep-dive slot (Tue 11/24 10:00 PT preferred if that works)
- Redwood to deliver: cost model (2M tokens) by Tue 11/24, SOC2 + data retention docs by EOD 11/22 (done  attached), MA template for redlines
- Procurement: Please route contract comments to procurement@finedge.com; we'll incorporate and return redlines within 2 business days after receipt.

I'll calendar the security deep-dive tentatively for Tue 11/24 10:00 PT and will update or cancel based on Claire's reply. Appreciate the quick turnaround  we're excited to move this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
